basic_info.description: Turnkey elegance in the prestigious Sunnyside area! This beautifully updated 2-bed, 1-bath home offers 1,000 sq. ft. of stylish and functional living space, seamlessly blending classic charm with modern design. The open-concept layout is filled with natural light and high-end finishes.  The home features a fully landscaped backyard with stunning views and a finished garage. Updates include new flooring, windows, electrical, plumbing, and a high-efficiency heating system. Additional highlights: upgraded electrical panel, EV charging station, and a state-of-the-art AV system with built-in speakers throughout.  A truly move-in-ready home designed for comfort, convenience, and entertainment. Easy to show—contact the listing agent for details.
